quick.title: Quick Experience
quick.step1: Make sure the frontend code folder named frontend exists at the project root
quick.step2: Click Create or Select Table on this page to enter the drag-and-drop designer
quick.step3: Click or drag fields from the left field library. The first field has no suffix; duplicates get _01, _02 automatically
quick.step4: Optionally expand Advanced Settings to configure module name, biz name, generation type, menu and buttons
quick.step5: Click Generate Code to generate in one click (saves config and generates code; if menu generation is enabled, the menu tree is persisted automatically). Preview the generated files below
quick.warning: Note: when creating from scratch the DB table does not exist yet; run the Ent migration after generation to create it.
